verdict.element_note: On the element split NOTHING approaches 0.82 -- including the baseline (0.26-0.50). The bar was mis-specified for that split: 0.82 is a COMBINATION-level in-sample number and does not transfer to predicting an unseen element.
verdict.headline: The learned model's entire advantage is INTERACTION CAPTURE among elements it has already seen. Given an unseen promoter it is WORSE than the additive baseline and below chance (-0.014): it learned identity, not sequence. The only genuine sequence generalisation comes from deltaG, which alone lifts held-out-element R^2 to 0.14-0.33.
